name: marketingskills
headline: Essential Marketing Skills for AI Agents
short_description: Marketingskills offers essential marketing capabilities tailored for Claude Code and AI agents, covering areas like CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering to enhance your marketing strategies.
author: coreyhaines31

sections.overview:
Marketingskills is a directory skill that equips AI agents and Claude Code with foundational marketing expertise. The skill covers conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting techniques, search engine optimization, analytics interpretation, and growth engineering methodologies. It enables marketing professionals and teams to leverage AI agents for strategy development, content optimization, and performance analysis. By integrating these essential marketing domains into a single skill, it helps practitioners automate and enhance their marketing workflows without requiring manual tool switching or fragmented resources.
Optimize website conversion rates through targeted A/B testing and CRO techniques.
Create compelling marketing copy for landing pages and advertisements to engage potential customers.
Improve search engine rankings by implementing effective SEO strategies and content optimization.
Analyze marketing performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and drive better results.
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the market positioning of [COMPETITOR] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Identify their top 3 marketing strategies that have contributed to their success. Suggest how [OUR_COMPANY] can adapt or improve upon these strategies to gain a competitive edge. Provide specific examples and data points to support your recommendations.
```
Copy

```
After analyzing the market positioning of Acme Corp in the SaaS industry, it's clear that their top three marketing strategies have significantly contributed to their success. First, Acme Corp has effectively leveraged content marketing to establish thought leadership. Their blog, which receives over 500,000 monthly visitors, covers a wide range of topics relevant to their target audience. To adapt this strategy, [Our Company] should invest in creating high-quality, SEO-optimized content that addresses the pain points of our target market. Second, Acme Corp has successfully utilized account-based marketing (ABM) to target high-value accounts. They have created personalized content and experiences for key decision-makers within these accounts, resulting in a 30% increase in conversion rates. [Our Company] can adopt a similar approach by identifying high-value accounts and tailoring our marketing efforts to their specific needs. Lastly, Acme Corp has effectively used social proof to build trust and credibility. They have showcased customer success stories and testimonials on their website and social media channels, which has led to a 25% increase in website traffic. [Our Company] can follow suit by highlighting our satisfied customers and their achievements.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
sections.overview_vi: Marketingskills là thư viện trang bị cho AI Agent kiến thức chuyên môn vững chắc về marketing. Các chủ đề bao gồm tối ưu hóa tỷ lệ chuyển đổi (CRO) thông qua thử nghiệm A/B, nghệ thuật viết tiêu đề bài đăng thu hút, tối ưu hóa công cụ tìm kiếm (SEO) và phân tích hành vi người dùng. Giúp các marketer tận dụng tối đa sức mạnh của AI trong việc lên kế hoạch chiến dịch, viết bài và theo dõi hiệu suất tự động mà không cần chuyển đổi công cụ thủ công.
sections.setup_vi:
Cài đặt trực tiếp qua Claude:
`claude install coreyhaines31/marketingskills`
Hoặc clone dự án:
`git clone https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills`
sections.usage_vi: Yêu cầu AI phân tích vị thế thị trường của đối thủ cạnh tranh, đề xuất chiến lược tiếp thị nội dung và cách thức áp dụng tối ưu hóa tỷ lệ chuyển đổi.
